items.title: Breadth BROADENS to broad while the vol-target throttle DE-RISKS below 1.0 as the completed-bar frontier ADVANCES 2026-08-03 → 2026-08-04 into a fresh 52-week high on an unchanged calm VIX band: from the pre-close read to the after-hours read on the newly completed 2026-08-04 daily bar, market-heatmap breadth flips 57.53% narrow → 62.16% broad (margin -2.47 → +2.16) while the vol-sizing owner's SPY conditional-vol forecast rises 14.5644% → 15.7376% and its regime flips NORMAL (67.46th pct, throttle ×1.03 up-size) → ELEVATED (79.365th pct, throttle ×0.95 down-size) — participation widens into new highs at the same time position-sizing de-risks — even though the headline VIX band is unchanged (16.5, score 0) and SPY sits at the 52-week high (pctFrom52wHigh 0, bull-stack, ma50Dist +3.51, ma200Dist +10.43).
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior frozen-frontier axes (price-markdown, coverage-expansion, gamma-band-migration, wall-cross, and the gamma-cushion-compression / pin-widening axis), which all held the completed-bar frontier STATIC and lived inside the options / gamma micro-structure. This is a distinct PARTICIPATION-vs-SIZING axis measured ACROSS a one-bar frontier ADVANCE (2026-08-03 → 2026-08-04): breadth broadening and a new-high close would normally pair with a FALLING conditional-vol / risk-ON throttle, but here the two SPLIT — breadth broadens while the vol-target model raises its realized-vol percentile into elevated and throttles sizing BELOW 1.0. The headline VIX band stays calm (16.5, score 0), so the de-risk signal comes from the realized-vol model, not implied vol — an implied-calm / realized-elevated divergence. Emit only when the frontier advances by exactly one completed bar AND breadth crosses narrow → broad AND the vol-target throttle crosses from ≥1.0 to <1.0 with its regime moving to elevated, so a quiet re-read that leaves breadth or the throttle side unchanged does not trip the flag.
items.method: Add a 'breadth-broadens-while-vol-target-derisks-on-frontier-advance' composite test that compares the prior-window read to the current read across a ONE-BAR frontier ADVANCE (dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate increments 2026-08-03 → 2026-08-04 with freshSymbolCount==symbolCount, carriedSymbolCount==0, missingSymbolCount==0, and the swing bar count +1: 507 → 508). Assert FIVE joint conditions: (1) FRONTIER ADVANCE by exactly one completed daily bar; (2) BREADTH REGIME FLIP = market-heatmap leadership crosses narrow → broad (breadthPct 57.53 → 62.16, threshold 60, margin -2.47 → +2.16); (3) SIZING DE-RISK = the vol-sizing throttle crosses from ≥1.0 to <1.0 (1.03 → 0.953) with regime NORMAL → ELEVATED and the conditional-vol percentile rising (67.46 → 79.365, forecast 14.5644% → 15.7376%); (4) NEW-HIGH CONTEXT = bench SPY at the 52-week high (pctFrom52wHigh 0) with a bull-stack (ma50Dist +3.51, ma200Dist +10.43); (5) IMPLIED-CALM GUARD = the VIX band is unchanged and calm (16.5, score 0) so the de-risk originates in realized, not implied, vol. Emit only when (1) AND (2) AND (3) AND (4) AND (5) all hold; condition (3) crossing below 1.0 while (2) broadens is the divergence.
